title: Zoning map change for Sojourner Truth-Mapes, Bronx
summary: This land use application would amend the zoning map in Bronx Community District 6, changing an R7-1 district to R8, removing a C1-4 district and establishing a new C2-4 district. The change is tied to the Sojourner Truth-Mapes rezoning proposed by 2136 Crotona Parkway Housing Development Fund Corporation. It falls within City Council District 15.
